newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay mulls IATA fare hike proposal.
newsitem.headline: Cathay mulls IATA fare hike proposal.

text.p: Hong Kong flag carrier Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said on Tuesday it was considering the International Air Transport Association's (IATA) proposal to raise air ticket prices by three percent.
"We will take the IATA's recommendations into consideration," said C.F. Kwan, manager of corporate communications.
The IATA proposed the hike at a meeting last Friday in response to a rise of about 40 percent in fuel prices this year.
Cathay Pacific chairman Peter Sutch said last week the airline was considering imposing a surcharge on its passenger tickets.
"Our position has not changed and we are still considering it," said Kwan. "We have not decided whether we will raise airfares or not, and if so, the size of the increase."
